projects.title: Full Stack Modern E-Commerce Platform
projects.description: Architect and deploy a high-concurrency e-commerce platform with product catalogs, shopping cart, Stripe payment webhooks, inventory management, and role-based admin controls.
projects.real_world_use_case: Powers enterprise direct-to-consumer digital commerce operations handling tens of thousands of simultaneous shoppers with zero checkout downtime.
learning_objectives: Design scalable database schemas with PostgreSQL and transactional safety
Implement asynchronous payment webhooks with Stripe and idempotent order creation
Build responsive frontend user interfaces with React, Tailwind CSS, and optimistic updates
Deploy production applications with continuous integration and CDN asset caching
features: Dynamic course/product browsing with multi-facet filters (category, price, rating)
Server-side cart management with session persistence
Stripe Checkout Session & Webhook fulfillment verification
Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) for Admin, Teacher, and Student
Real-time order invoice generation & delivery tracking

steps.title: Database & Schema Architecture
steps.description: Design tables for users, products, orders, order items, and transactions with foreign key cascades and indexes.

steps.title: Secure REST API Endpoints
steps.description: Construct authenticated Express endpoints with JWT validation and Zod payload sanitization.

steps.title: Frontend UI & Cart State
steps.description: Create responsive catalog and cart views with optimistic quantity updates and empty states.

steps.title: Stripe Payment Gateway Integration
steps.description: Configure Stripe payment intents, checkout redirect, and signed webhook listeners.

steps.title: CI/CD & Cloud Deployment
steps.description: Containerize using Docker, configure environment secrets, and deploy with SSL certificates.

projects.database_requirements: PostgreSQL 15+ with pg_trgm extension for full-text product search, transactions with SERIALIZABLE isolation for checkout.
projects.api_requirements: Express.js with JWT middleware, rate limiting on payment endpoints, CORS whitelist.
projects.ui_requirements: Tailwind CSS with responsive mobile breakpoints, accessibility compliance (WCAG AA).
projects.deployment_requirements: Automated GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline, staging environment, production health probe.

projects.title: AI-Powered Resume Analyzer & Job Matcher
projects.description: Build an AI application that parses PDF resumes, extracts competencies, scores ATS compatibility, and matches candidates with real job openings using semantic vector embeddings.
projects.real_world_use_case: Used by tech recruiting agencies and university career cells to automate applicant pre-screening and provide candidate feedback.
learning_objectives: Parse unstructured PDF documents into structured JSON entities
Generate and compare semantic vector embeddings using cosine similarity
Construct prompt engineering pipelines for structured LLM evaluation
features: PDF drag-and-drop file upload with virus/size validation
ATS Scorecard (Formatting, Keywords, Impact metrics, Quantifiable results)
Job Description vs Resume match percentage with gap suggestions

steps.title: Document Parsing Engine
steps.description: Extract clean text from PDF and DOCX documents.

steps.title: LLM Prompt Engineering
steps.description: Design structured JSON prompts for ATS score and bullet-point critique.

steps.title: Interactive Dashboard UI
steps.description: Visualize scores with circular progress gauges and color-coded suggestions.

projects.title: Enterprise DevOps CI/CD & Kubernetes Pipeline
projects.description: Implement a complete GitOps automated deployment pipeline using Docker, GitHub Actions, Kubernetes (Minikube/EKS), Helm, and Prometheus/Grafana monitoring.
projects.real_world_use_case: Production deployment standard used by high-velocity software engineering organizations.
learning_objectives: Containerize multi-tier applications with multi-stage Docker builds
Write Kubernetes manifests (Deployments, Services, Ingress, Secrets, ConfigMaps)
Set up Prometheus monitoring metrics and Grafana alerts
features: Multi-stage Dockerfile achieving sub-50MB production images
Automated lint, unit test, and image security scan on Pull Request
Zero-downtime rolling updates with liveness and readiness probes
Grafana dashboard tracking request latency (p95, p99), error rate, and CPU utilization

steps.title: Observability & Metrics
steps.description: Hook up Prometheus scraping and Grafana dashboards.

projects.title: Real-Time Collaborative Code Editor
projects.description: Develop a Google Docs / VS Code Live Share style browser code editor supporting multi-user concurrent typing, WebSockets, syntax highlighting, and live chat.
projects.real_world_use_case: Powers remote pair programming sessions, technical coding interviews, and coding education classrooms.
learning_objectives: Understand operational transformation (OT) and conflict-free replicated data types (CRDTs)
Build resilient WebSocket synchronization rooms with reconnection handling
Create high-performance syntax highlighting in React
features: Room creation with shareable unique URL
Multi-cursor presence showing participant name and color
Real-time syntax highlighting for JS, Python, and HTML
Built-in audio/video or text chat for collaborators

steps.title: WebSocket Server Setup
steps.description: Handle room connections, heartbeats, and room broadcast.

steps.title: Editor & Cursor Sync
steps.description: Synchronize document edits and remote cursor coordinates.
